title: Automated Research Operations and Human-Gated Publication Lifecycle
summary: KESPA V2.01 operationalized a formal Research Operations lifecycle that freezes baseline/suite state, persists benchmark results, produces sanitized exports, records cryptographic commitments through NexLedger, runs recurring regression and telemetry jobs, prepares research-review material, and keeps public publication human-gated. Automatic public Git publishing remains disabled by design, and public-release attestation is separated from local benchmark completion.
deduplication_boundary: The first TK-54 benchmark result is separately represented by KESPA-BENCH-005; this note documents the surrounding research-operations lifecycle and publication-control architecture rather than republishing its performance result.
